The directors of Merger Subsidiary 1 immediately prior to the Effective Time shall be the initial directors of the First Surviving Corporation, each to hold office in accordance with the certificate of incorporation and by-laws of the First Surviving Corporation, and the officers of Merger Subsidiary 1 immediately prior to the Effective Time shall be the initial officers of the First Surviving Corporation, in each case until their respective successors are duly elected or appointed and qualified or until their earlier death, resignation or removal.
